8 Pc Executive Tea Set With Tray Black

This elegant tea set includes a black teapot with a gold-accented lid and handle, accompanied by 6 matching black cups with gold rims and white interiors. The set is presented on a gold-colored tray with a ribbed design on the edges. This exquisite 8-piece executive tea set with a tray in black is a perfect blend of elegance and sophistication. The set features a stunning black teapot with a gold-accented lid and a matching gold handle, adding a touch of luxury to the overall design. Alongside the teapot, there are six matching black cups, each adorned with gold rims around the top and white interiors for a beautiful contrast. The entire set is elegantly presented on a gold-colored tray that boasts a ribbed design along its edges, enhancing the premium feel of the tea set. The black and gold color combination gives the tea set a classy and executive look, making it ideal for serving tea in a sophisticated setting, whether it’s a formal gathering, a tea party with friends, or even as a decorative piece in a dining or living area. The gold accents on the teapot, cups, and tray add a hint of opulence, while the black base keeps the look grounded and refined.
